def clean(df):
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip().str.title()
    allowed_species = ["Adelie", "Chinstrap", "Gentoo"]
    df = df[df['species'].isin(allowed_species)]
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    species_avg = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
    overall_avg = df['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
    result = species_avg.to_dict()
    result['all'] = overall_avg
    return result
